title: Publish current Linux driver evidence
requires: Linux host exposing Slang CPU plus production CUDA and Vulkan on identified physical hardware
scope: Build one clean Linux revision and publish separate Slang CPU, CUDA and Vulkan qualification inputs from the same host where available, executing applicable public-API reference, physical-quality and adverse-lifecycle contracts without inferring one driver from another.
acceptance: Each result pins clean source, exact driver binary, CPU/GPU and OS, native driver and compiler/Slang/CUDA/Vulkan toolchain plus immutable contract hashes.

All applicable obligations execute independently per advertised driver; cross-driver agreement is retained as reference evidence but cannot replace analytic physical quality, and all failures, missing and unsupported scope remains visible.

Register and regenerate the per-driver evidence index from a Linux and a second-OS checkout without weakening byte-stable identity; unavailable production drivers remain explicit rather than fabricated or skipped as passes.
evidence: PASS: clean eed669e build; CPU executed 12/30 cases and CUDA/Vulkan each executed 30/30, with exact binaries, toolchains and hardware pinned in revisioned bundles.
PASS: rigid kinematic 61/61 and brick penetration gates passed on all three drivers; CUDA equal-fluid 18/18 passed; missing formal lifecycle fingerprints remain explicit.

PASS: evidence index is valid and qualification-complete; Linux local and Windows Actions job 117758435016 regenerated it byte-stably. Zero capabilities qualify because known contract/evidence gaps remain visible.
